name: Donut Dongle gameID v0.7.13
body:
**RT6X Support**
- HD-15/2M transfer-reliability. Really only pertains to when using the Donut Dongle's 3.5mm aux serial port.
- “Stage Latest Experimental” uses ACK Upload automatically with HD-15 serial.

**File Transfer**
- ACK mode is now split into separate Upload and Download controls with defaults chosen based on baud rate and serial used.
- Download cancellation has been reworked and diagnostics removed.

**Upload/Download Speeds**
For me, when setting the RT4K Input to "Front CVBS" and having my display powered on, results in the fastest speeds. (results in a low Loop Time in  "Stats")

Vacation starts tomorrow, so taking a break for a bit. :-)
